'''Dania Francis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Iskalonian]] from one of the eleven minor species in [[the School]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Dania Francis was the chief aide and lover of Iskalonian ''First to Swim'', [[Mone]]. She discovered that [[Kiro]] had indeed survived from his trip to [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] and had returned to [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]].
